_comment: Single source of truth for tickers removed from the universe after delisting (M&A, bankruptcy, going-private). Honored by the daily-refresh integrity gates (check_earnings_calendar_integrity.py, check_ticker_identity.py) so deliberate removals don't trip silent-drop guards, and by sync_dolthub.py's universe gate so a stale forecast JSON can't resurrect them. Loaded via scripts/delisted.py. Add an entry (ticker -> reason/delisted_on/source) when a holding is confirmed delisted.

AMWD.reason: Completed all-stock merger into MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC); American Woodmark delisted.

APLS.reason: Acquired by Biogen Inc. (BIIB); Apellis Pharmaceuticals delisted from Nasdaq.

AVB.reason: Merged into Vivmark Residential (NYSE: VMRK) in a merger of equals with Equity Residential; closed 2026-08-17. Former AvalonBay holders own ~51% of VMRK. Predecessor retired — do not rename AVB→VMRK (would mix two companies' earnings histories onto the successor).
AVB.source: manual (user-confirmed merger of equals; successor VMRK is a new ticker)

AVNS.reason: Taken private by American Industrial Partners at $25.00/share cash; Avanos Medical delisted from NYSE.

BLD.reason: Acquired by QXO, Inc.; TopBuild Corp. (NYSE: BLD) delisted.

CPRX.reason: Acquired by Angelini Pharma at $31.50/share cash; Catalyst Pharmaceuticals delisted from Nasdaq.

CSGS.reason: Acquired by NEC Corporation; CSG Systems International delisted.

CTRA.reason: Merged into Devon Energy (DVN) in an all-stock deal; Coterra ceased trading.

EA.reason: Taken private by a Public Investment Fund / Silver Lake / Affinity Partners consortium at $210.00/share cash; Electronic Arts delisted from Nasdaq.

EQR.reason: Merged with AvalonBay into Vivmark Residential (NYSE: VMRK) in a merger of equals; closed 2026-08-17, VMRK first trade 2026-08-18. Former Equity Residential holders own ~49% of VMRK. Predecessor retired — do not rename EQR→VMRK (would drop only EQR history onto a ~51/49 combined company).
EQR.source: manual (user-confirmed merger of equals; successor VMRK is a new ticker)

GDEN.reason: Completed going-private transaction; Golden Entertainment delisted from Nasdaq.

GTLS.reason: Acquired by Baker Hughes at $210.00/share cash; Chart Industries delisted from NYSE.

MASI.reason: Acquired by Danaher Corporation (NYSE: DHR); Masimo delisted from Nasdaq.

NSA.reason: Acquired by Public Storage; National Storage Affiliates delisted from NYSE.

PRA.reason: Acquired by The Doctors Company; ProAssurance Corporation (NYSE: PRA) delisted.

SNCY.reason: Acquired by Allegiant Travel Company (NASDAQ: ALGT); Sun Country Airlines delisted from Nasdaq.

TERN.reason: Acquired by Merck via $53.00/share cash tender offer; Terns Pharmaceuticals delisted.

TMHC.reason: Acquired by Berkshire Hathaway at $72.50/share cash; Taylor Morrison Home delisted from NYSE.

TWO.reason: Two Harbors common is being taken private by CrossCountry Mortgage at $12.00/share (expected close 2026-08-25). Common already absent from NYSE directories. TWO$A is Series A preferred (NYSE: TWO PRA), not a successor common ticker — do not rename TWO→TWO$A.
TWO.source: manual (user-confirmed go-private; TWO$A is NYSE preferred, not a rename)

WBS.reason: Acquired by Banco Santander; each Webster common share converted into $48.75 cash plus 2.0548 SAN ADSs. WBS delisted from NYSE.
